references.title: Beck Spectroscope
references.evidence: Supplement only: Amici/direct-vision concept. Its violet-compressed/red-expanded claim conflicts with Lotus and its own handheld page and is not adopted; historical Beck is not asserted to have three prisms.

references.title: Gem Testing with the Spectroscope
references.evidence: Diffraction models have fixed slit and balanced spacing. Prism spectra expand violet and compress red. Historical Beck model described as five-prism; present three-prism count is an explicitly illustrative Amici choice.
references.license_or_usage: Reference only; no verified open licence. Source pixels remain in ignored assets-source and are not embedded in public assets.
